prompt:
Create a new KFB ink blob monster character sheet, The Off Piste Beginners. Supplied original PNGs are style inputs for rounded ink anatomy, thick modeled lids, plasticine surface and handcrafted accessory scale. Create exactly SIX full individual upright actors in a 3-column by 2-row landscape 1536×1024 PNG with a true transparent alpha backdrop. Each actor at equal substantial scale inside their own logical cell, entire prop and all droplets inside generous transparent gutters and outer margin. No scenery, floor, labels, border, branding, joined figures or background color. Each is a dark charcoal continuous footless ink splat with subtle plum sheen and rich softly rounded clay, small goo hands, bare goo base and expressive asymmetrical organic lobes. Compact costume pieces wrap the blob. Thick filled dark lids with white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Teeth inside lips. Offbeat tourist satire, six different poses, looks and mouth shapes. Visible wear and miniature handcrafted volume. No copied eyepatches, wings, military insignia or outfits from references. Wardrobe family: tangerine, violet and icy cyan retro ski wraps and knitwear. Row-major cast:
1. Female-read embarrassed ski beginner: tilted pear, upward guilty eyes, tight uneven grin. Prop: two short crossed skis held in arms.
2. Male-read confused piste reader: tall rippling splat, eyes going opposite ways, tiny pursed mouth. Prop: folded piste map with simple colored trails.
3. Male-read outraged lift-pass holder: wide squared body, one bulging eye, open asymmetric complaint. Prop: oversized colorful pass on a short lanyard.
4. Male-read sleepy lodge regular: low soft bean, heavy lids, slow closed smile. Prop: big cocoa mug with one fat marshmallow.
5. Female-read delighted souvenir collector: plump comma, eyes shining upward, crooked open chuckle. Prop: small snow globe with a tiny cabin inside.
6. Male-read nervous snowboard renter: lean upright blob, clenched mouth, eyes drawn inward. Prop: short bright snowboard hugged across belly.
Emphasize eyes and acting. Keep every figure independently usable as a sightseeing bystander. Hold props close. Separate all six in clear alpha.
